subject: Compliance cadence & sprint handoff — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA acceptance
messages:
From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@morainebank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Park <d.park@morainebank.com>
Date: 2025-11-14T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — security gates and retention clarifications

Karthik — thanks for the intro call earlier. Per our procurement checklist we need a short, concrete MAP that surfaces the security/compliance gates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA items, data retention) and who owns evidence. Our legal team needs the DPA redline and a statement about residency/retention windows.

Immediate asks from Moraine:
- Confirm SOC 2 scope (type II in scope? encryption at rest details).
- SIG/CAIQ: which control families are covered by Redwood-managed controls vs customer-side?
- DPA: confirm data flow (hosted API only) and propose retention buckets (30/90/365 days) plus purge SLA.
- Evidence owners: who will upload SOC 2 report and SIG snapshot to our shared drive?

Could you send a one-page MAP and a timeline for sign-off this week? We aim to finish legal review and procurement by 11/25.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Turner
Senior Sourcing Manager, Moraine Bank

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@morainebank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates and retention clarifications

Hi Emily — great to meet you earlier. Draft MAP attached (MAP_v2_Moraine_EvidenceMatrix.xlsx) and a proposed sprint cadence below. High level answers first, then a short plan: 

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II (report date Q3-2025). Scope includes hosted API, auth plumbing, and encryption-at-rest using customer-configurable KMS.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood-managed controls cover logical access, change control, incident mgmt. Customer-side controls (data classification/access) are clearly called out in the matrix.
- DPA & retention: we propose default buckets at 30 days (session cache), 90 days (short-term logs for debugging) and 365 days (audit & billing traces). Purge SLA: 14 days from approved request for non-archival data. For EU/residency we can pin region to us-west or eu-west per the Private deployment option.

Proposed MAP sprint (two-week rapid path to sign):
- 11/14 (today): Deliver MAP and DPA redline (attached DPA_redline_v3.docx); identify evidence owners.
- 11/17: Evidence intake — Redwood to upload SOC 2 summary + SIG snapshots to shared drive; Moraine to confirm acceptance criteria.
- 11/20: Legal redline resolution session (30m).
- 11/25: Final sign & kick deployment (if procurement OK).

Acceptance criteria (security gate pass):
1) SOC 2 report uploaded and owner assigned (Redwood: Security Ops).
2) SIG/CAIQ snapshot with callouts for customer responsibilities and compensating controls accepted by Moraine.
3) DPA redline resolved with retention buckets and KMS/escrow terms agreed.
4) Test plan: smoke test of hosted API to validate data residency config (if selected) and a demo of deletion/purge workflow.

Owners: 
- Redwood evidence owner: Soojin Lee (soojin_lee@redwood.ai) — SOC 2 & SIG uploads
- Redwood legal: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai) — DPA negotiation
- Moraine evidence owner: Emily Turner — acceptance signoff

I'll follow up with the intake upload link and DocuSign for the DPA next.

-Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

(Attachment: MAP_v2_Moraine_EvidenceMatrix.xlsx; DPA_redline_v3.docx referenced)
From: Daniel Park <d.park@morainebank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Emily Turner <emily.turner@morainebank.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-14T13:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates and retention clarifications

Thanks — quick points from legal: 
- We need a binding clause that ensures purge requests are honored within the SLA and a verification artifact (deletion token or audit record).
- For DPA: can Redwood agree to a 30-day cure period for discovered incidents and provide notification timelines (T+24 for incidents affecting customer data)?
- HSM/KMS: Moraine requires support for customer-managed keys for the production Private deployment; hosted API must document encryption-at-rest key scope.

Action: please add the purge-verification artifact paragraph to the DPA redline and confirm incident notification language. Also confirm whether the 365-day bucket is archival-only (read-only) or accessible for live queries.

-Daniel
Sr. Counsel, Moraine Bank

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates and retention clarifications

Daniel/Emily — thanks for the pointers. Confirming Redwood positions we will: 
- Add purge-verification: Redwood will provide a deletion token and an audit record stamped with customer request ID; token and record will be delivered to the customer and stored in our audit store for 90 days post-purge for verification unless customer requests extended retention for compliance reasons.
- Incident notification: Redwood will adhere to T+24 initial notification for incidents affecting customer data; full incident report within 7 business days and remediation timelines in follow-up. We'll add the 30-day cure period language to the DPA redline.
- KMS/HSM: For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (CMK) via KMS integration; for hosted API we support return-to-customer key wrapping and an escrow option for enterprise customers.
- 365-day bucket: default is archival-readonly; we can enable live-query access for up to 90 days post-ingestion if needed (requires acceptance in MAP).

Next steps: 
- I will update DPA_redline_v3.docx with the purge-verification clause and incident notification language and circulate a clean copy by EOD 11/14.
- Soojin will upload SOC 2 summary and SIG snapshot to the shared intake folder and tag evidence owners by 11/17.

Please confirm if this meets Moraine's immediate acceptance criteria or if you want a short (20m) sync tomorrow.

Best — Laura
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
